title: Fostering STEM Identity through Storytelling: Links to Belonging, Self-Efficacy, Classroom Climate, and Lab Performance
content:
Chem. Educ. Res. Pract., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5RP00230C, Paper
Karen Ho, Alfie Chen, Douglas B. Clark
This study explores how integrating an approach to storytelling, called contextualized storytelling, into the laboratory classroom may be related to students’ self-efficacy, sense of belonging, classroom climate, and lab performance....
